title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theater on 1979-12-01
source: Low-gen Audience Cassette (Maxell UDXLII-C90); Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1KHz) > Soundforge 9 > CD Wave Editor > Trader's Little Helper > Flac16  Transfer, edit, pitch correction by Bob Morris, May 2012

ai_review.summary: An unexpectedly excellent audience (AUD) tape that sounds killer for its era.
ai_review.review: The reviewer is thrilled with this AUD recording, calling it a "killer" and "thoroughly SLAMMIN" tape, especially given its age. Pitch correction work is praised as spot‑on, turning an otherwise unknown taper’s source into a highly enjoyable listen. No specific comments on the musical performance are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review but it is overwhelmingly positive about the audio quality; lack of show‑related commentary limits confidence, so rating reflects strong recording with unknown performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the AUD tape as "killer" and praises excellent pitch correction; despite being from an unknown taper, the sound is clear and impressive for its time.
